newsitem.title: USA: Booth Creek Ski sells $110 mln in junk bonds.
newsitem.headline: Booth Creek Ski sells $110 mln in junk bonds.

text.p: The following 144a offering of high-yield bonds from Booth Creek Ski Holdings Inc was priced on Thursday in the U.S. via lead manager CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Corp.
Booth Creek is a privately-held ski resort company.
BORROWER BOOTH CREEK SKI HOLDINGS INC
TYPE SR NOTES ISS PRICE 100 FIRST PAY DATE 9/15/97
LAST MOODY'S CAA YIELD 12.5 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS SPREAD 589 bps CALLABLE NON-CALLABLE FOR
NOTE: The company may call up to 30 percent of the issue at 112.50 if it completes an equity offering within a three-year period, market sources said.
